description: The South Asian Media and Cultural Studies Conference (SAMCS) is an annual hybrid conference hosted by Florida State University in Tallahassee, Florida, now in its 13th year, focused this edition on 'Digital Frontiers: Media, Culture, and AI in South Asia'.
